Title: Technical Operations Center Manager
Description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Service Reliability & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.
* Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.
* Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.
* Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.
* Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

Major Incident Management & Swarming
  
  

* Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.
* Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.
* Make swarming repeatable through shared queues, structured triage-ready information and timely engagement of the right technical and business partners.
* Coordinate internal teams and third-party providers through restoration, stakeholder communication and service validation.
* Ensure blameless postmortems convert incident learning into prioritized problem-management, reliability and prevention work.

Problem Management, Toil Reduction & Automation
  
  

* Maintain a ranked backlog of repeat incidents, operational toil, alert noise and manual work, with owners and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the conversion of repeatable procedures into versioned runbooks, scripts, workflows, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Apply AI-assisted triage and knowledge discovery where appropriate, with human oversight, security controls, auditability and clear escalation paths.
* Improve the quality, findability and lifecycle management of operational knowledge, including runbooks, known-error records, as-builts and shift documentation.
* Track automation adoption and toil hours avoided using the results to redirect capacity toward reliability engineering and service improvement.

Change, Release & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Strengthen risk-tiered change practices, including pre-checks, peer review, testing evidence, implementation plans, monitoring and rollback readiness.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to shift operational readiness earlier in the lifecycle, including supportability, observability, runbooks and ownership before release.
* Analyze change-related incidents and failure patterns leading corrective actions that improve change success and reduce recovery time.
* Support paved-road standards and a transparent exception process for common infrastructure, cloud, identity, network and systems patterns.

Global Coordination & Follow-the-Sun Operations
  
  

* Facilitate structured handoffs between global teams, ensuring the incoming shift receives current service health, active incidents, risks, decisions, next actions and escalation needs.
* Maintain consistent severity, response, handoff, change and review practices across regions while respecting local context and coverage requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across time zones, technical domains, business units and strategic vendors.
* Participate in a rotating global coverage and escalation model, including occasional out-of-hours or weekend coverage when required. The schedule should support sustainable coverage rather than routine weekend office attendance.

People Leadership & Capability Building
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop Technical Operations Center specialists, creating a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Set clear expectations for performance, incident leadership, documentation, operational discipline and customer experience.
* Hire, onboard and develop talent while building role-based learning paths and cross-training plans for critical domains.
* Establish resilient coverage with documented SME and backup relationships, reducing key-person dependency.

**Skills/Abilities**
Job Requirements:
  
  

* Deep technical knowledge in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations or related disciplines.
* Ability to assess impact, prioritize under pressure, communicate clearly and make sound decisions during high-severity events.
* Experience with service ownership, observability, SLOs/SLIs, operational readiness, runbooks and reliability metrics.
* Experience reducing operational toil through scripting, workflow automation, self-service or similar engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of cloud, identity, network, systems and/or enterprise infrastructure operations.
* Ability to build trust across engineering, security, business technology, vendors and geographically distributed teams.
* Commitment to blameless learning, continuous improvement and inclusive people leadership.

**Experience**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations, IT service management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three or more years leading technical teams, major incident response, operational programs or cross-functional reliability initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical infrastructure or applications in a complex, globally distributed environment.
* Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service-level and knowledge-management practices.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI-assisted operations, event correlation, anomaly detection or intelligent triage, with appropriate governance and human review.
* Experience implementing or improving a service catalog, SLO framework, error-budget practices or reliability scorecard.
* Experience with ITSM, observability, automation/orchestration and knowledge-management platforms.
* ITIL, SRE, cloud, automation or related certification.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Industry-standard IT certifications are desirable; ITIL, SRE, cloud or automation certifications are a plus.

Title: Non-Traditional Environment (NTE) Security Manager, Amazon Corporate Security
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites to deliver fast, low-latency broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide. Getting those satellites to orbit depends on secure operations at partner-operated launch, test and processing facilities around the world.  
  
Amazon Corporate Security (ACS) is hiring a Non-Traditional Environments (NTE) Security Manager to lead physical security delivery for Amazon Leo’s operations at third-party and non-traditional Leo locations in the US and abroad. These include test labs, payload processing facilities, secure storage sites and temporary operating locations where Amazon must work within host organization constraints to deliver security. We're looking for a leader who lives Amazon's Leadership Principles, especially Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust and Bias for Action.  
  
Reporting to the Amazon Leo Physical Security Sr. Manager, you'll own the delivery of ACS security services at sites that Amazon doesn't control. Your services protect Leo people, satellites, hardware, infrastructure, and intellectual property (IP) through influence, partnership and well-run vendor management. You'll work closely with the facility operator, the launch provider, local authorities and guard vendors. Inside Amazon, you'll work with Leo IP and Infrastructure Security, Trade & Compliance, Legal, Logistics and Leo mission teams. The environment is ambiguous and changes fast. Schedules move, requirements change, and you'll often be the most senior Amazon security leader on site.  
  
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be U.S. citizens to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Deliver best-in-class security services to meet business and security partner defined outcomes, focused on enhancing the safety and security of all Amazon employees, contractors, and visitors
* Manage day-to-day security operations for a diverse portfolio of locations and customers with unique requirements in an ambiguous environment
* Proactively audit and identify security gaps at Amazon Leo locations while managing audit action items to close, working under tight duration guidelines
* Be the trusted security advisor and subject matter expert for all levels of Amazon and Amazon Leo employees in the assigned area of responsibility, through high-quality communication and excellent briefing skills
* Implement and improve security plans, security systems, guarding operations, policies, and programs
* Travel within the US and internationally for up to 45 days at a time to manage security delivery and build local partnerships
* Coordinate physical security incident response and reporting
* Respond to customer security concerns
* Earn trust through key customer and stakeholder engagements, and liaison with external partners
* Work cross functionally with Intellectual Property and Infrastructure Security, Legal, Trade & Compliance, EHS, and Leo business teams to establish scalable physical security standards that meet the businesses’ needs
* Understand US Government regulatory requirements for security assurance and compliance

  
A day in the life  

* Oversee guarding operations and hold guarding vendors accountable for quality and frugality
* Build relationships with internal and external security and Amazon Leo partners
* Develop and monitor performance metrics to track and improve performance. Implement measurable processes to improve performance and communicate outcomes
* Conduct site security assessments and identify trends in findings and develop and implement measures to address systemic issues
* Plan and lead security readiness activities across sites
* Manage cross-functional projects and operations. Drive team(s)/partners to meet program and/or product goals
* Conduct initial incident investigations and collaborate with specialist security teams to support the customer

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of program management, project management or product management experience
* Travel up to 50% of the time
* Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)
* Bachelor's degree or above in Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, International Security, Business Management or related fields
* Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
* Experience drafting policies, standard operating procedures, internal guidance, and legally-mandated letters

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in multicultural communication, or experience and familiarity with US culture
* Experience in security operations, risk management, and incident response
* Experience in security management in a multi-location global corporate environment
* Experience creating reports, interpreting metrics and driving overall insights or analysis
* Experience with Lenel or other alarm access control systems
* CPP, PSP, CISM or similar certification

Title: Technical Delivery Manager
Description:
**About MedEdge**  
MedEdge Solutions is the largest provider of data platform management and data translation services in the pharmacy industry. We’ve worked in this space for more than 20 years and have supported over 400 specialty and infusion pharmacies, including 95 percent of the largest.

Our platforms pick up data from the systems pharmacies run on, translate it, move it on a set cadence, and deliver it to the people who need it to run the business of pharmacy. Pharmacies and health systems rely on that data every day, so when a feed breaks or a release slips, the people on the other end notice. Our headquarters is in Westfield, Indiana, and our regional headquarters is in Fort Smith, Arkansas.

**The role**  
You own technical delivery for the software and data platforms behind that work. It’s one job covering two teams. Our engineers build the platforms that move and translate data. Our data services team builds the custom conversions, integrations, mappings, and reports, and the cloud data infrastructure under them, such as Snowflake.

You know where each piece stands, when it will be ready, where it breaks down, and when it gets fixed. When a date slips, you find out why that day, get a recovery plan and a new date in writing, and hold the team to it. You keep the roadmap and the delivery plan, and anyone in the company can ask you where something stands and get a straight answer within the hour.

You don’t manage client projects. Our client project team owns the client plan and the client conversation. You own the technical side beneath it, and you give them dates they can count on.

You report to the CEO and work every day with the engineering lead and the data services lead. Client success, client project management, and sales come to you when they need to know what’s coming. When the CEO has a new request, it goes through you. When two priorities collide and he has no preference, you make the call.

**Your first year**  
In the first 30 days you build the delivery plan from nothing, take over the software team’s sprint cadence, and send your first Friday report. By day 60 the roadmap is published and a weekly review is running with data services. By the end of the year, the technology we commit to ships on the date we commit to, and nobody has to ask the CEO where things stand.

Description:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
We are looking for an experienced
**IT Manager**
to lead and continuously improve IT operations across Snoonu's corporate offices, warehouses, operational sites, and growing regional footprint.
  
  
You will lead the team responsible for ensuring our employees and operations have reliable, secure, and effective technology to do their best work—from IT service delivery and end-user support to endpoint management, employee technology lifecycle, IT assets, access operations, workplace technology, and site readiness.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines
**strong operational discipline, technical judgment, people leadership, and a genuine service mindset**
. We are looking for a leader who can keep critical services running today while continuously making IT more proactive, automated, scalable, and ready for tomorrow.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**

* Lead IT operations and service delivery across corporate offices, warehouses, operational sites, and supported regional markets.
* Build and continuously improve a reliable, measurable, and user-focused IT service model covering incidents, service requests, escalations, major incidents, and problem management.
* Lead and develop the IT team, setting clear expectations for service quality, ownership, responsiveness, technical capability, and continuous improvement.
* Own the employee technology experience across onboarding, role changes, transfers, and offboarding, ensuring people have the right devices, accounts, software, and approved access at the right time.
* Oversee endpoint and workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, meeting-room technology, printing, and other employee-facing systems.
* Own IT asset management throughout the full lifecycle—from procurement and assignment to recovery, repair, replacement, reuse, and secure disposal.
* Strengthen operational identity and access processes, working closely with Cybersecurity, P&C, application owners, and business teams to ensure timely and accurate provisioning and deprovisioning.
* Ensure technology readiness for new offices, warehouses, operational sites, and market launches.
* Use service data, ticket trends, root-cause analysis, and employee feedback to identify recurring issues and drive meaningful improvements.
* Expand automation and self-service across onboarding, offboarding, access requests, ticketing, asset management, reporting, and other high-volume IT workflows.
* Improve knowledge management and reduce dependency on individuals through clear documentation, runbooks, self-service resources, and cross-training.
* Lead the response to major IT service disruptions, ensuring effective escalation, communication, restoration, and post-incident improvement.
* Manage IT vendors, service providers, technology procurement, licensing, and operational costs with a focus on service quality and sustainable value.
* Partner closely with Cybersecurity, Digital Innovation, Technology, P&C, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and other business functions.
* Support Snoonu's continued growth by building IT services and operating practices that can scale across teams, locations, and markets.

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**

* 4+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, IT service management, workplace technology, infrastructure support, or related areas, including people-management responsibility.
* Proven experience leading IT operations or IT support teams in a complex, fast-moving environment.
* Strong experience with IT service management, incident and request management, SLAs, escalation, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
* Hands-on understanding of endpoint management, identity and access operations, employee technology lifecycle, enterprise SaaS, collaboration platforms, and workplace technology.
* Experience managing IT assets across their full lifecycle, including inventory accuracy, procurement coordination, assignment, recovery, replacement, and disposal.
* Experience supporting multiple offices, warehouses, operational sites, or geographically distributed teams.
* Strong ability to use service metrics, operational data, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability and user experience.
* Experience managing vendors, service providers, contracts, procurement, and IT costs.
* Strong leadership skills and the ability to build accountability, develop people, manage capacity, and maintain high service standards.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, and senior leadership.
* A practical mindset and the ability to balance urgency, user needs, security, cost, and long-term scalability.

**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience in a high-growth technology, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, retail, fintech, or super-app environment.
* Experience supporting warehouses, dark stores, retail locations, or other operationally critical sites.
* Experience supporting multi-country operations, rapid organizational growth, or new-market launches.
* Experience with modern enterprise environments including Google Workspace, endpoint-management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management, SSO/IAM solutions, Slack, and enterprise SaaS applications.
* Experience automating IT workflows and integrating HR, identity, ITSM, asset-management, and collaboration platforms.
* Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent technology certifications.

Title: General Manager
Description:
Tahreez Sport & Entertainment (TSE) is a joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, combining Tahreez’s strong Saudi foundation, operational capabilities, and market insight with PMY’s globally recognised expertise in live environment technologies and major event delivery.

Together, TSE delivers integrated venue technologies and operational solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and audience experiences across stadiums, arenas, and live entertainment environments throughout Saudi Arabia.

Combining deep local insight with decades of global experience, TSE provides end-to-end capabilities across strategy, consulting, design, implementation, operations, software, data intelligence, and live experience technologies.

Backed by more than 500 professionals, over 1,000 clients across 15 countries, and more than 40 years of combined industry expertise, TSE is uniquely positioned to deliver world-class venue and event technology solutions tailored to the Saudi market.

United by a shared commitment to innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, Tahreez and PMY work together to create connected, future-ready live environments — delivering invisible technology with visible impact.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The General Manager – TSE will be responsible for growing and leading Tahreez Sports & Entertainment's business and operations across the Kingdom.

The role requires a commercially driven and entrepreneurial leader with a strong understanding of the Saudi market, capable of developing client relationships, converting opportunities into profitable revenue, and building and managing a growing organisation.

Working closely with the leadership of PMY Group and Tahreez, the General Manager will bring rigour, commitment and accountability to the execution of the business plan, ensuring operational excellence, financial discipline and sustainable growth.

The role will be instrumental in establishing the JV as a trusted advisor and delivery partner across sport, entertainment, venues, major events, technology and infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Growth**

* Develop and execute the Saudi Arabia growth strategy aligned to the objectives of both PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Identify emerging market opportunities, strategic sectors, and priority clients to support long-term growth.
* Provide leadership and direction to ensure sustainable and profitable business expansion.

**Business Development & Client Relationships**

* Lead the pursuit and conversion of new business opportunities across sports, entertainment, venues, events, technology, and infrastructure sectors.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with clients, government entities, developers, venue operators, event owners, partners, and industry stakeholders.
* Support bid strategy, negotiations, commercial discussions, and contract execution.

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee the successful establishment and operation of the Saudi business, ensuring appropriate governance, processes and controls are in place in alignment with Tahreez and PMY Group.
* Provide executive oversight of project delivery performance, client satisfaction, resource planning, and operational effectiveness.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the Saudi Arabia business plan, revenue targets, profitability objectives, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Monitor business performance and implement actions to achieve growth and margin targets.
* Ensure commercial discipline, risk management, and strong financial governance across all activities.

**Joint Venture Leadership**

* Maintain a collaborative and effective partnership between PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Ensure strategic alignment between both organisations while balancing commercial, operational, and cultural objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders from both JV partners.
* Support the implementation of agreed governance frameworks and reporting requirements.

**People & Culture**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Saudi-based team as the business grows.
* Create a culture aligned with the values and behaviours of both PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Provide mentoring, coaching, and leadership development to employees.
* Drive employee engagement, accountability, and performance excellence.

**Stakeholder & Government Engagement**

* Develop strong relationships with key government authorities, regulatory bodies, strategic partners, and industry leaders.
* Maintain awareness of market developments, regulatory requirements, and strategic initiatives relevant to the business.
* Act as the primary representative and spokesperson for the Joint Venture within the Kingdom.
* Contribute to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace in accordance with company Occupational Health and Safety policies, operational standards, and relevant legislative requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Significant senior leadership experience within Saudi Arabia or the GCC region.
* Demonstrated experience establishing, leading, or scaling a growing business operation.
* Strong commercial acumen with proven business development and client relationship management capability.
* Experience working across sports, entertainment, venues, major events, technology, infrastructure, construction, or related sectors.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior executives, government representatives, and strategic partners.
* Proven financial management and P&L leadership experience.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and people management skills.
* Cultural awareness and ability to operate successfully within a joint venture environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction, Technology, Sports Management, or a related discipline.

**WHY TAHREEZ SPORTS AND ENTERTAINMENT?**

* **Shape the Future** Be part of a company bringing world-class venue and live environment technologies into Saudi Arabia across sports, entertainment, and major destinations.
* **Create Real Impact** Contribute to delivering intelligent technologies that enhance safety, operational efficiency, connectivity, and audience experience across the Kingdom.
* **Work Alongside Experts** Collaborate with industry professionals and global specialists across venue technologies, integrated systems, operations, and live event environments.
* **Grow With Purpose** Build your career in a dynamic sector that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and hands-on experience on ambitious projects.
* **Be Part of Something Bigger** As a strategic joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, TSE combines global innovation with strong Saudi operational capability to deliver intelligent solutions with real impact.

### **Company Overview**

TRANSFORMING THROUGH TECHNOLOGY - PMY Group is a full-service technology solutions company that supports venues and major events to enhance their infrastructure, experience, and intelligence. We specialise in providing cutting-edge AI, data, and cloud solutions to sports, media, and entertainment sectors, helping them achieve their full potential through the transformative power of data and AI.

Title: Senior Director - Roads and Mobility - AG6
Description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director - Roads and Mobility to lead the strategy, operational governance and lifecycle performance of Qiddiya City's roads, bridges, tunnels and associated infrastructure, including Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS).
  
  
As the accountable asset owner, you will establish the standards, operating model and investment priorities needed to deliver a safe, reliable and resilient road network. Working closely with development teams, transport operators and relevant authorities, you will oversee operational readiness, maintenance and service-provider performance, supporting everyday city operations, phased openings and major events.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Define and deliver the roads and mobility asset strategy, operating model and long-term plans
* Lead lifecycle management, inspection, maintenance and renewal planning across roads, bridges, tunnels and associated infrastructure
* Set the ITS strategy, overseeing system availability, network monitoring and integration with city command-and-control platforms
* Lead asset-owner input into design, commissioning and handover, ensuring maintainability and operational readiness
* Oversee budgets, procurement requirements and service providers, driving safety, quality, performance and value
* Coordinate network operating plans, roadworks, closures and incident-response arrangements with authorities and operational stakeholders
* Lead multidisciplinary teams and establish performance reporting covering asset condition, network availability, risks and investment priorities

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering or a related engineering discipline; a relevant master's degree is preferred
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in roads, transport infrastructure or network asset management
* At least 5 years in senior leadership, accountable for significant asset portfolios, budgets and multidisciplinary teams
* Demonstrated asset-owner or client-side leadership across road networks, bridges and tunnels, including maintenance and renewal programmes
* Strong experience in ITS oversight, operational handover, outsourced service delivery and coordination with authorities and transport operators
* Strong capability in risk-based asset management, lifecycle investment and stakeholder leadership; professional registration and major-event or regional experience are advantageous.

Title: IT MANAGER
Description:
Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia  
Regulatory Body: Capital Market Authority (CMA)  
Reports To: CTO and CEO

**Company Overview:**

We are in the process to become a CMA-licensed FinTech investment firm based in Riyadh, KSA, operating a modern retail equity trading platform that enables seamless buying and selling of stocks. As a growing firm with a focused setup, we are looking for a pragmatic, reliable, and versatile IT Manager to oversee our technical ecosystem, ensure strict regulatory compliance, and support our day-to-day operations efficiently.

**Role Summary:**

The IT Manager will serve as the hands-on technical lead for our trading platform and office infrastructure. This individual will manage local IT operations, coordinate with specialized third-party vendors (cloud hosting, software vendors, and cybersecurity providers), and ensure full compliance with Saudi Capital Market Authority (CMA) technology guidelines and data security policies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* CMA & Regulatory Compliance: Align IT security policies, systems, and disaster recovery procedures with CMA requirements and local KSA cybersecurity controls.
* Infrastructure & Systems Availability: Oversee cloud-hosted environments, trading platform availability, system monitoring, and core internal infrastructure to minimize downtime.
* Vendor & Partner Management: Serve as the main point of contact for external technology vendors, software contractors, cloud service providers, and SMS/payment gateway partners.
* Data Security & Incident Management: Ensure basic cybersecurity hygiene, access controls, backups, and data protection standard operating procedures across all company endpoints and servers.
* Internal IT Support & Operations: Manage office IT hardware, internal networks, onboarding/offboarding user access, and day-to-day technical support for employees.

**Must-Have Qualifications & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* At least 2 years of general IT administration/management experience, ideally within Saudi Arabia.
* At least 1 year of basic Linux server administration (experience with command line interface, network management with iptables).
* Familiarity or direct exposure to Saudi CMA regulations, SAMA cybersecurity guidelines, or NCA framework basics.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a hands-on, self-starter mindset suited for a lean tech team environment.
* Good written and spoken communication skills in Arabic and English.

**Nice To Have:**

* Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, VPNs, networking) and managing external tech vendors.
* Fluent Arabic.

Title: Regional Director
Description:
****ABOUT US****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With a combined team of over 10,000 professionals worldwide, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver. We actively seek new opportunities that drive innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manager over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia. For further information, visit www.bgis.com .
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
At BGIS, our culture is built on three foundational pillars:
  
  

* Culture of Care: We deeply care for each other, our clients, partners, and the communities we serve.
* High Performing Teams: We go Above and Beyond to deliver exceptional services. INTEGRITY, OWNERSHIP, RESPONSIVENESS, INITIATION, VISIBILITY, DRIVE, and INTEGRATION are core to high performance.
* Unwavering Commitment to Sustainability: We conduct every action with a focus on preserving our earth.

****SUMMARY****
For the assigned region(s), the
**Regional Director**
is accountable for operations, financial management and meeting service delivery obligations in a specified Geographical region that includes several facilities, employees and clients.  This role is expected to understand, coach and train the team in all regulatory and client requirements.  In addition, this role is also responsible for contributing to strategic and account management plans and objectives and people leadership.
  
  
This role will work in collaboration with all key BGIS departments to ensure full support of all activities and play a key role in our INTEGRATED approach to operating buildings.
  
  
**Opportunities for Development:**
  
  
At BGIS we are committed to the development of our people – offering them opportunities to learn and grow into various roles.  Success in the role offers Team Members the opportunity to explore various roles – some include:
  
  

* On Account and expanded Operational Leadership
* Facility Management Office roles to support accounts,
* Project Management leadership roles to lead and execute projects

****KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Health, Safety, Environment & Security**
  
  

* Follow and apply all Health and Safety and Emergency Response, aligned with both BGIS and Client expectations.to ensure safety of all employees and building occupants.
* Work in collaboration with BGIS Health Safety and Environment Teams for support and direction on key programs to emphasize Safety Culture
* Accountable for meeting all internal and external health, safety, environment and security-related requirements
* Accountable for the safe delivery of all work performed

**Account Management**
  
  

* Continuously engages clients in discussions to understand and anticipate needs, identify and recommend additional services
* Provides input and contributes to the development and execution of strategic account expansion plans
* Recommends additional pull-through services
* Participates in and contributes to quarterly business reviews
* Contributes to contract renewal and business development activities
* Contributes to account governance
* Adherence to Contract Specific MSA (Master Service Agreement)
* Manages the BGIS ECE Program for the specific client group
* Responsible for results and action plans related to the Likely to Recommend Survey.

* Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s)

* Community college diploma preferably in business administration
* More than 10 years of facility management work experience

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

  
  
  

**Job Description**

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

  
  
  

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

  
  
  

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

  
  
  

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

  
  
  

**What Fiix Business Systems Does**

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

  
  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

* Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
* Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
* Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
* Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
* Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
* Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.
  

  
  

Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
* Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
* Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
* Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.
  

  
  

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.
  

  
  

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
* Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
* Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
* As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
* Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
* Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
* Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
* Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
* Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.
  

  
  

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience.
* Legal authorization to work in Canada or the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
* Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25% of the time.
* Typically requires 8 years of management experience.
  

  
  

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Proven track record of stabilizing and scaling business systems or revenue operations in a high-demand environment with a significant backlog.
* Experience owning a roadmap for Salesforce-based go-to-market and quote-to-cash systems.
* Experience leading business systems transformation, operating model design or platform modernization (e.g., CRM/quote-to-cash modernization or post-acquisition operating model design).
* Experience in a SaaS or subscription software business, including CPQ, subscription billing, renewals and revenue recognition processes.
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and CPQ, and connected tools (e.g., NetSuite, Boomi, Gainsight, Marketo, LeanData, Zendesk).
* Experience leading organizational change, restructuring teams or scaling operations.
* Experience working in a product management / PMO / engineering operating model and with agile delivery.
* You can explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.
* Familiarity with industrial software, asset management or maintenance (CMMS) markets.
* Experience defining the operating model for a SaaS business within a larger, multi-business enterprise.
* Experience working with large, multi-year enterprise transformation programs and global IT organizations.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Revenue Cloud / revenue management, and commerce platforms.

Title: Senior Manager/Director of IT & Security
Description:
**About Neurophos**
===================

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

Join us and shape the future of computing!

**Location:** Austin, TX or Sunnyvale, CA. Full-time onsite position.

**Reports To**: SVP of Engineering

**FLSA Status**: Exempt

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager or Director of IT & Security to own Neurophos's IT infrastructure and information security programs across our Sunnyvale and Austin sites. Today, an external managed service provider (MSP) delivers help desk, endpoint protection, and around-the-clock security monitoring. You will own architecture, security posture, and compliance. You will direct the MSP for routine operations and decide what to bring in-house, in what order, and with what staffing.

Much of this does not exist yet. You will define it as the company grows past 150 people.

This is a builder role. You start as the senior-most IT and security voice in the company with no internal team, and you will do much of the hands-on work yourself. That includes standing up servers, writing configuration code, and running incident response. As the function grows, you will hire and lead the team that runs it.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Engineering Compute & Private Cloud**

  + Design, deploy, and operate on-premises Linux servers and clusters for EDA/CAD tools, photonic simulation, and performance modeling.
  + Run batch scheduling (SLURM, LSF, or equivalent), floating license servers (FlexNet/FlexLM), and license-aware queue policy. Forecast compute, storage, and license demand ahead of tapeouts and program milestones.
  + Operate shared storage, scratch tiering, snapshots, and backup, with restore and disaster recovery procedures tested on a set schedule.
  + Manage provisioning and configuration as code (PXE, standard images, Ansible or equivalent), and own patch and lifecycle cadence across the fleet.

  **Identity, Access & Developer Platform**

  + Own SSO and identity architecture in Okta: SAML application onboarding, SCIM provisioning, verified deprovisioning, group and role design, MFA, and privileged access.
  + Administer GitHub Enterprise, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Atlassian, and engineering and AI tooling. This covers sharing controls, retention, external-collaborator policy, license inventory, and renewals.
  + Run periodic access reviews and enforce least-privilege access to chip design repositories, process design kits (PDKs), and other high-value engineering data.

  **Network, Cloud & Sites**

  + Design and stand up wired and wireless networks at both sites, covering switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPN, and zero-trust access. Keep lab, corporate, and customer-facing environments segmented.
  + Administer public cloud (Azure preferred), covering account structure, IAM, networking, and cost visibility. Own hybrid connectivity between sites and cloud.
  + Lead the IT build-out for new office and lab space, including ISPs, circuits, and conference room A/V and video conferencing standards.

  **Security Operations & Incident Response**

  + Own SIEM/EDR, logging, and intrusion detection across endpoints, servers, and cloud, and direct the MSP's 24x7 monitoring.
  + Run vulnerability management end-to-end, covering asset scanning, prioritization, and remediation tracking with engineering teams.
  + Own the incident response runbook and serve as incident commander during security events, including forensic analysis and post-mortems.

  **Governance, Risk & Compliance**

  + Author and enforce security policy: acceptable use, data classification, network segmentation, backup and disaster recovery, and AI tool usage.
  + Lead the SOC 2 Type II program (Vanta, Drata, or similar) with engineering, the General Counsel, and external auditors.
  + Work with the General Counsel on export control (EAR/ITAR) access controls, foundry and IP-vendor data handling obligations, and customer data protection.
  + Lead customer security reviews, questionnaires, and technical due diligence with customers and investors. Assess the security risk of new SaaS and infrastructure vendors.

  **Endpoints**

  + Own the Mac, Windows, and Linux fleet: standards, imaging, MDM, encryption, patch compliance, procurement, asset tracking, and secure disposal.
  + Provide escalation support for the issues the MSP help desk cannot resolve, especially on Linux and engineering workstations.

  **MSP Governance, Budget & Team**

  + Serve as the single accountable owner of the MSP relationship: scope, SLAs, escalation paths, quarterly reviews, and cost.
  + Own the IT and security budget, report posture and roadmap to engineering leadership, and hire and develop the internal team as functions move in-house.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or security engineering, including 3+ years leading an IT or security function, team, or outsourced provider.
* Experience as the primary IT or security owner at a company under 200 people, or building a function from near zero through rapid growth.
* Hands-on Linux administration below the application layer, including storage, networking, kernel and driver troubleshooting, and fleet-scale configuration management.
* Experience operating HPC or EDA compute, including batch schedulers (SLURM, LSF, or equivalent) and floating license servers.
* Demonstrated ownership of SSO/IdP and IAM/PAM architecture (Okta strongly preferred), including SCIM provisioning and verified deprovisioning.
* Hands-on ownership of a SIEM/EDR stack, a vulnerability management program, and incident response.
* Direct experience leading at least one SOC 2 Type II audit cycle and responding to customer security questionnaires or technical due diligence.
* Practical network engineering: switching, VLANs, enterprise Wi-Fi, firewall policy, VPN, and DNS/DHCP. Able to design a site network and stand it up.
* Working proficiency in at least one major public cloud (Azure preferred) and working knowledge of export control frameworks (EAR/ITAR) as applied to technical data.
* Willingness to work onsite and travel between Sunnyvale and Austin as needed.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience supporting semiconductor or hardware engineering organizations, including Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA environments, foundry PDK access requirements, and lab/test networks.
* Experience moving outsourced IT or security operations in-house, including standing up an internal help desk, MDM, or endpoint program.
* Enterprise storage and data protection (NetApp, Pure, Rubrik, Veeam, or similar) with multi-site replication and disaster recovery testing.
* High-performance networking (RoCE, InfiniBand) or rack-scale hardware bring-up.
* CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or OSCP, and familiarity with NIST CSF or ISO 27001.

**What We Offer**
=================

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world.

**Benefits**
------------

Join a team that invests in your future and your well-being. At Neurophos, we offer:

* 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions.
* Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery.
* 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success.
* Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance.
* Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t.

Compensation Range: $225K - $275K

Title: Digitalisation & Technology Manager
Description:

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping our digital strategy, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring the effective adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation, advanced analytics, digital platforms, and construction technologies. * Ensure security and confidentiality by design, making these requirements an integral part of technology selection and digital processes rather than an obstacle to innovation. Confidentiality and control of information are foundational principles of the new Construction Company.
* Connect business, construction and technology, acting as the interface between management, project teams, technical functions, technology providers and specialist partners.

  
**Qualifications**

**You're a Great Fit If You Have**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience leading digital transformation, innovation, or technology-driven business improvement initiatives.
* Experience implementing digital platforms, automation tools, AI solutions, analytics platforms, or enterprise technologies.
* Strong understanding of change management and technology adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business needs and technology solutions.
* Experience within construction, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, energy, logistics, or other project-based industries is preferred but not mandatory.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred**

* Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI
* Automation and Digital Workflows
* Data Analytics and Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* BIM and Digital Construction Technologies
* Common Data Environments (ACC, BIM 360, ProjectWise, etc.)
* Digital Twins, IoT, Reality Capture, or Smart Infrastructure Solutions
* Cloud-based collaboration and enterprise platforms

  
**Additional Information**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Digital principles are embedded into the company's operating model from day one.
* Core business systems and digital platforms are successfully implemented.
* Manual and repetitive processes are reduced through automation and digital workflows.
* Measurable productivity improvements are achieved through technology adoption.
* Data-driven decision-making becomes part of everyday operations.
* The organization develops a sustainable culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* A secure, scalable, and integrated digital ecosystem supports future business growth.

Title: IT Director of Operations
Description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure, the IT Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the organization's Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, service request fulfillment, and end-user support functions. This role is accountable for delivering reliable, responsive, secure, and consistent technology support to corporate offices, service centers, remote workers, and operating locations.
  
  
The Director establishes a customer-focused operating model, develops high-performing support teams, improves service quality through standardization and automation, and ensures operational processes produce measurable improvements in user experience, service availability, response time, resolution time, change success, and cost efficiency. The position partners closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Information Security, Enterprise Applications, Clinical Applications, Human Resources, Compliance, Finance, vendors, and business leaders, and serves as a senior leader during major incidents and high-risk changes.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and related operational support functions, including organizational design, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year IT operations strategy and service improvement roadmap aligned with business growth, acquisitions, technology modernization, cybersecurity requirements, financial objectives, employee experience, and operational risk tolerance.
* Own the Service Desk operating model, including intake channels, call handling, ticket triage, prioritization, escalation, request fulfillment, knowledge management, shift coverage, quality assurance, customer communications, and service-level performance.
* Lead Field Services and deskside support across distributed locations, including onsite incident resolution, device deployment and recovery, site support, technology readiness for openings and relocations, executive support, inventory coordination, and local vendor management.
* Own IT service management practices and governance, including incident, request, major incident, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, and continual improvement processes, using ITIL-aligned practices and clearly defined ownership, controls, and measures.
* Lead enterprise Change Control and the Change Advisory Board process. Establish risk and impact criteria, approval thresholds, peer and technical review requirements, testing expectations, implementation and rollback standards, maintenance-window governance, emergency change controls, post-implementation validation, and reporting.
* Serve as the senior operational leader for major technology incidents. Ensure rapid business-impact assessment, clear command and escalation structures, timely stakeholder communications, cross-team coordination, service restoration, executive updates, after-action reviews, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective actions.
* Establish problem management practices that identify recurring incidents and service degradation, prioritize root-cause investigation, assign accountable owners, track known errors and workarounds, and verify that permanent corrective actions reduce repeat demand.
* Build and govern a usable service catalog, supported by defined services, request offerings, ownership, fulfillment workflows, service targets, knowledge articles, and customer-facing expectations.
* Improve employee technology experience through self-service, automation, shift-left support, remote-support tools, standardized knowledge, proactive communications, customer feedback, and reduction of avoidable contacts and repeat incidents.
* Partner with engineering, security, and application teams to establish effective operational handoffs, support readiness, monitoring and alert response, escalation paths, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria before new or changed services enter production.
* Ensure effective joiner, mover, and leaver support in coordination with Human Resources, Identity and Access Management, Security, and business leaders, including equipment, access requests, onboarding readiness, transfers, and timely recovery of company assets.
* Establish asset and endpoint support controls, including device inventory accuracy, stock and depot processes, warranty and repair coordination, refresh planning, secure disposal, loaner equipment, peripheral standards, and accountability for equipment assigned to users and locations.
* Define and report meaningful operational metrics, including contact volume, abandonment rate, speed to answer, first contact resolution, response and resolution attainment, mean time to restore, backlog age, reopen rate, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, change success rate, emergency change rate, incident recurrence, field dispatch performance, and cost per contact.
* Use performance data, customer feedback, quality reviews, trend analysis, and process audits to identify service gaps, prioritize improvements, and hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Manage operating budgets, forecasts, staffing models, contracts, licensing, support tools, managed-service providers, hardware support partners, and vendor performance. Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership without creating unacceptable service, security, compliance, or resilience risk.
* Lead operational due diligence and integration for acquisitions, divestitures, new locations, relocations, and major business initiatives, including support discovery, staffing impacts, device and asset planning, service onboarding, cutover support, communications, and stabilization.
* Ensure operational services comply with company policies, contractual requirements, data-protection obligations, records requirements, and healthcare-related security and privacy requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Communicate service performance, customer-impacting risks, staffing needs, process maturity, investment priorities, and improvement progress clearly to technical teams, business leaders, executive leadership, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned and provide hands-on operational leadership when business-critical conditions require it.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The employee may be asked to perform other job-related duties consistent with the role.*
**Job Requirements**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, service desk, field services, or technology operations, including at least five years leading technical teams or managers in a complex, multi-site enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading Service Desk, Field Services, IT service management, change enablement, major incident management, problem management, and service improvement functions.
* Experience establishing service levels, operating procedures, quality controls, staffing models, escalation structures, knowledge management, service catalogs, and performance reporting.
* Experience with enterprise IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, BMC Helix, or comparable tools, including workflow, reporting, knowledge, and self-service capabilities.
* Experience managing operating budgets, strategic vendors, managed-service providers, and distributed support delivery. Experience in healthcare, home health, hospice, post-acute care, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting acquisitions, site openings or relocations, large technology deployments, endpoint refreshes, organizational change, and critical-incident response is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, major incident, configuration, and continual improvement practices.
* Strong knowledge of service desk and field support operations, including call and ticket workflows, prioritization, escalation, workforce planning, queue management, remote support, deskside support, asset handling, and customer communications.
* Ability to design and govern mature change controls using business impact, technical complexity, implementation risk, security exposure, validation requirements, rollback readiness, segregation of duties, and approval thresholds.
* Ability to lead major incidents using clear command roles, business-impact assessment, technical workstreams, communication cadences, restoration priorities, and disciplined after-action follow-through.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, collaboration tools, endpoint security, remote-support technologies, identity and access processes, and common enterprise support dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret service metrics, identify demand and failure patterns, distinguish activity from outcomes, and translate data into staffing, process, automation, and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to improve customer experience while balancing service quality, security, compliance, standardization, speed, cost, and operational risk.
* Strong financial and vendor-management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, contract review, licensing analysis, staffing and sourcing models, and service-level accountability.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate operational performance, business impact, risks, and recommendations in clear business terms.
* Demonstrated commitment to documentation, automation, knowledge-centered support, standardization, continuous improvement, service ownership, customer experience, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to participate in after-hours escalation as needed, support planned maintenance or deployment windows, and travel to company locations based on business needs.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4 Managing Professional, HDI Support Center Manager, HDI Support Center Director, Certified Change Management Professional, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or comparable credentials are preferred, not required.
* Positive attitude and commitment to the Company's culture, core values, ethical standards, privacy expectations, and service-oriented operating model.

**Location:**
Hybrid, TN
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
Something Else That Sets Us Apart From Other Companies Is The Quality Of Our Most Valuable Resources – Our People! We Are Dedicated To Living Out Our Culture As Defined By Our Core Values, “CAPLICO”
  
  

* Customer Second – We prioritize and support our team so they can deliver exceptional care.
* Accountability – Own your work and outcomes.
* Passion for Learning – Grow continuously with curiosity and culture.
* Love One Another – Build authentic, respectful, and trusting relationships.
* Intelligent Risk Taking – Innovate and challenge the status quo.
* Celebrate – Recognize the small wins, they add up!
* Ownership – Be the CEO of your role.

**Additional Benefits**

* True Work-Life balance – We believe in taking care of yourself before you take care of others!
* Full benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match)
* Paid time off, holiday pay, and professional development
* Your voice matters! - Work with other passionate and high-achieving leaders who care deeply about patient outcomes and team success.

**About Pennant Services**
We support over 250 home health, hospice, senior living, and home care operations across 19 states. Our Service Center model empowers local leadership while providing centralized clinical, legal, HR, IT, and compliance support to help ensure high-quality care.
  
  
www.pennantgroup.com
