Title: Director, IT Operations
Description:
**About Ascent**
Ascent Developer Solutions is a leading private lending platform, serving real estate developers nationwide in the acquisition, renovation, and construction of residential real estate. Founded by a leadership team with a deep understanding and personal experience in virtually every facet of real estate development, Ascent is uniquely positioned to create custom, innovative lending solutions for a variety of real estate development business strategies.
  
  
**The Role**
Ascent Developer Solutions is seeking an experienced Director of IT Operations to lead and mature our cloud-first, Microsoft-based technology environment. Reporting to the SVP, Technology, this role owns the reliability, security, and performance of all IT systems and services across the organization — infrastructure, endpoints, identity, collaboration, and end-user support. The Director leads a small internal IT operations team and directs our Managed Service Provider (MSP), owns the IT operations budget and roadmap, and partners with information security, HR, and business leaders to keep systems available, compliant, and cost-effective as the company scales.
  
  
**The Work**

* Own the reliability, performance, and security of the company's technology environment — network, endpoints, servers, cloud and hybrid workloads, and collaboration systems.
* Lead planned network infrastructure modernization, including a firewall and switch refresh.
* Administer the Microsoft 365 environment, including tenant configuration, licensing, mail flow, and security baselines.
* Direct endpoint management and device lifecycle — provisioning, Microsoft Intune (MDM), patching, imaging, and refresh — across an on-site and hybrid workforce.
* Own the IT service desk and end-user experience, defining and meeting service-level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution.
* Operate identity and access management within Microsoft Entra ID, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, and least-privilege/role-based access.
* Own the technology portion of user onboarding, offboarding, and role changes in close coordination with HR — account and license provisioning, equipment, role-based access, and timely deprovisioning (same-day for involuntary separations).
* Serve as the primary owner of the MSP relationship, directing scope and priorities, managing performance against SLAs, and defining the split between internal and MSP-delivered work.
* Direct IT hardware and software procurement, standardization, and asset and license inventory; manage carriers and technology vendors, including contracts, SLAs, performance reviews, and renewals.
* Continuously monitor IT systems for performance and reliability, proactively addressing issues to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.
* Operate core security controls in partnership with information security leadership — vulnerability and patch management, endpoint protection, logging, and email security.
* Own business continuity and disaster recovery, including backups, recovery testing, and incident-response readiness.

**GENERAL DUTIES**

* Own the IT operations budget; forecast, track, and report spend, including cloud and SaaS cost optimization.
* Build and maintain the IT operations roadmap aligned to company growth, headcount, and facilities plans, such as office moves and new sites.
* Lead, coach, and develop the internal IT operations team.
* Develop, enforce, and update IT policies, standards, runbooks, and best practices to support a secure and efficient technology environment.
* Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and self-service.
* Maintain detailed documentation of system configurations, vendor agreements, and IT processes.
* Lead IT projects from conception to completion — including risk management and mitigation.
* Support compliance and audit programs (e.g., SOC 2) by maintaining accurate IT and control documentation and remediating findings.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor offerings to enhance IT capabilities and streamline operations, working with the MSP where appropriate.
* Provide regular updates and clear communication on IT initiatives, risks, and progress to executives and cross-functional teams.

**Your Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8+ years in IT operations or infrastructure, including 3+ years leading staff and/or managing an MSP and vendors, preferably in real estate finance or another regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise infrastructure, identity, endpoint management, and Microsoft 365.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune (MDM).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals — firewalls, VPN, segmentation, Zero Trust principles, and IAM.
* Cisco Meraki experience a plus.
* Experience running an IT service management (ITSM)/service-desk function and meeting defined SLAs, plus budget ownership and vendor/contract negotiation.
* Experience supporting compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2) and business continuity/disaster recovery.
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., ITIL, Microsoft M365/Azure, CISSP, or Security+).
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**The Pay**
Salary range is up to $180,000 per year, with a discretionary bonus of 15% per year
  
  
**The Work Environment**

* This role works on-site from Ascent's Encino office, Monday - Thursday (Fridays are work-from-home).

**Our Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. Our benefits include four health plans, two dental plans, health savings account with employer contribution, flexible spending accounts, vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and other optional benefits from which to choose.
  
  
**Our Pledge**
We pledge to be fair and considerate in hiring and promoting individuals, ensuring everyone can contribute their fullest potential regardless of background, identity, or personal circumstances. By promoting equal opportunity, we not only enhance our workplace but also contribute to a more just and equitable society. At Ascent, we stand united in building a community where everyone is empowered to succeed. Thank you for joining us on our journey towards a more inclusive future.

Title: IT Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

The Texas General Land Office is seeking a Manager VII (IT Operations Manager) within the Information Technology Services Department of the agency.

Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support GLO programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**Our Mission:**

The Texas General Land Office primarily serves the schoolchildren, veterans, and the environment of Texas. The agency does so by preserving our history, maximizing state revenue through innovative administration, and through the prudent stewardship of state lands and natural resources.

**What Your Contributions to the GLO Will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Free Parking
* Defined Retirement Benefit Plan Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
* Medical Insurance - State pays 100% of the health plan premium for eligible full-time employees and 50% of the premium for their eligible dependents. The State pays 50% of the eligible part-time employees' premium and 25% for eligible dependents.
* Optional Benefits such as dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Minimum of 96+ Hours of Annual Leave a year \*\*Annual leave increases with length of service.
* Professional Development Opportunities: The GLO offers numerous courses to help our employees grow using resources through LinkedIn Learning and our EAP provider.

**Veterans:**

Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser:

Military Crosswalk for Occupational Category - Information Technology

**How to Apply:**

* To be considered for this position, please submit your application online through the CAPPS Career Site (preferred method) or complete a State of Texas Application in WorkInTexas at www.workintexas.com. It is not necessary to apply through both WorkInTexas and the CAPPS Career Site.
* Applications must be fully completed and include a comprehensive employment history, detailing job titles, dates of employment, employer names, supervisors' names and phone numbers, and a summary of responsibilities. Submission of a résumé is also required.
* In accordance with federal law, all individuals selected for hire will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the appropriate employment eligibility verification documentation upon hire.
* Positions assigned to this classification are designated as security-sensitive pursuant to Texas Labor Code, Section 301.042.
* Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. The agency is unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa.

Title: Enterprise Program Manager (ELM)
Description:
**About Us**  
At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.  
  
Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.  
  
Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

**About the Role**  
Litify is looking for a seasoned and strategic Enterprise Program Manager to lead our most critical, high value customer implementation projects for the Enterprise Legal Management product suite. This role will become an expert on our ELM product and focus on the full services lifecycle, from pre-sales (involved in scoping and approving SOWs), through implementation (implementation partner management, timeline management, risk mitigation and management) and successful go-live and hand-off.

This role serves as the central point of coordination between enterprise customers, Litify internal teams, and implementation partners to ensure successful, on-time, and high-quality deployments. You will manage program governance, delivery health, and stakeholder alignment while driving outcomes that accelerate customer value and strengthen Litify's partner ecosystem.

**The Enterprise Program Manager is responsible for the following:**

* Be the SME in Enterprise Legal Management product implementations at Litify
* AI forward thinker who can implement AI best practices in a complex enterprise projects
* Oversee and own end-to-end implementation projects in partnership with Service Implementation partners to ensure project success and drive on-time delivery
* Collaborate with the Product team on roadmaps and release plans and align with strategic objectives and priorities and educating both the Litify internal teams and the 3rd party partners running implementations
* Evaluate project team performance on individual projects and work to ensure that implementation teams have the tools, processes, and training required to deliver high quality implementations
* Identify issues and risk and ensure mitigation plans are defined or escalate as needed
* Design, pilot, and roll out new processes, best practices, standards, and KPIs as needed to improve team efficiency and effectiveness while avoiding unnecessary duplication of/variation from standard processes
* Evaluate team agile development practices, identify opportunities for improvement, and execute a visible plan for their achievement
* Own day-to-day communications with partners on project performance and progress
* Own process improvement in customer implementation cost reductions
* Own introduction of AI to enhance implementation processes.
* Own process improvement for pre-sales, implementation and partner onboarding and certification

**A successful Enterprise Program Manager will exhibit the following:**

* Strong knowledge and understanding of the corporate legal operations
* Business and growth experience to work with implementation partners
* Demonstrated experience in program management and managing multiple projects with varying timelines, scope, budget, etc. concurrently
* Collaborative, flexible, cross-functional nature with an extreme ownership mindset
* Passion for winning and raising the bar in everything you do
* Expert use of project planning and tracking tools
* Ability to influence others even when you do not have direct authority over them

Disclosure:  
The estimated base salary pay range for this role is $140,000-155,000. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

Title: Central Program Management (TPE) - Program Manager, Staff
Description:
**Company**
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management
  
  
**General Summary**
The Staff Program Manager is a key member of the Central PMO within the Technology Planning and Edge Solutions (TPE) group at Qualcomm. This role focuses on 5G/6G technologies for chipset products for the Infra base station business. The Staff Program Manager develops, defines, and executes plan of record (POR), including: schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks for digital and mixed-signal IC (integrated circuit) chips and/or chipsets. Drives and monitors the chip/chipset programs from initiation through delivery, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders across functions on technical matters. Monitors budget/spending, on-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders. Driving the integration of silicon, systems, and software to deliver Infra base station products to new customers and to commercialize 5G/6G technologies.

* Build strong technical and program understanding to develop key insights and influence.
* Drives large cross-functional engineering teams (baseband, RF, antenna and power) across program life cycles from product conception to commercialization.
* Understand requirements priority and drive scoping and planning, including interdependencies, staffing constraints, and schedule optimization across multiple tech teams.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish clear Plan of Record commitments and enable prioritization.
* Establish rigorous execution discipline and communication processes, including risk management, mitigation, tracking, schedule trends vs. baseline, recovery actions, and executive reporting.
* Develop program indicators to manage program health, including quality and timelines.
* Tracks and manages all key metrics pertaining to a program and identifies when metrics deviate significantly from plan of record; escalates issues in a timely manner and proposes corrective actions.
* Develop and establish strong processes that streamline the development cycle and integrate multiple plans, dependencies, and deliverables effectively.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, channel requirements to respective development teams, and drive consensus on development schedules, plans and processes.
* Develop and maintain resource plans, identify resource gaps, and develop mitigation plans to achieve business objectives.
* Use verbal and written communication skills to convey complex information to multiple audiences, requiring strong negotiation and alignment skills.
* Work independently with little supervision.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 10+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* 5+ years of experience working with digital SOC and/or mixed-signal baseband and/or RF chips
* 5+ years of experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 3+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.
* 2+ years of experience with program management tools such as dashboards, Gantt charts, etc.

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

**Job Summary**
Eagle Wireless is seeking a Program Manager to own and drive customer programs through a phase-gate hardware development process — from initial engagement and design through EVT, DVT, PVT, qualification, certification, and ramp to mass production. * Manage BOM, ECO, and documentation control processes in coordination with engineering and supply chain teams.
* Track and help drive regulatory and carrier certification requirements (e.g., FCC, PTCRB, carrier certification) to support program milestones.
* Support manufacturing transfer and cutover activities, including coordination between design/engineering sites and manufacturing partners.
* Prepare and present program status reports, timelines, and risk assessments to internal leadership and customers.
* Identify and drive process improvements within the PMO to improve program predictability and delivery.

**Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, including 2+ years specifically managing hardware products through phase-gate NPI (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience managing an engineered hardware product — such as a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device — through a phase-gate development cycle to manufacturing release, from concept/design through qualification and into volume production.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers or external manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of phase-gate/stage-gate NPI processes (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), BOM/ECO management, DFx (DFM/DFT/DFA), and manufacturing readiness gates.
* Excellent cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to work across engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting program status to customers and leadership.
* Proficiency with program/project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira/Confluence, or similar) and standard office/productivity software.
* Experience in the cellular/IoT module, networking/telecom equipment, automotive electronics, or wireless communications industry.
* Familiarity with regulatory and carrier certification processes
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) for BOM, inventory, and production tracking.
* Experience managing programs across multiple manufacturing sites or geographies.

**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

The Manager, Architecture reports to the Vice President, AI and is responsible for leading the enterprise, domain and solution architecture teams supporting Fidelity Investments Canada. The role provides technical and people leadership to ensure technology solutions are designed and implemented in alignment with enterprise architecture standards, business priorities and the firm's long-term technology strategy.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise, architectural judgement and people management skills. They will work closely with Business, Engineering, Data, AI and Technology teams to translate enterprise architecture direction into practical solutions, guide complex technology decisions and support modernization initiatives across the organization.

A critical part of the role is close collaboration with Fidelity International (FIL) and international architecture counterparts. The Manager will work with global teams to align architecture standards, technology roadmaps and design practices, leverage shared enterprise capabilities and contribute to common architectural direction. They will help ensure Canadian business requirements are represented in global architecture discussions while promoting consistency, reuse and collaboration across regions.

A key focus of the role is to strengthen and mature the architecture practice, establishing consistent design principles, reference architectures, governance processes and ways of working that improve the quality, efficiency and consistency of technology delivery. As emerging technologies continue to reshape enterprise systems, the Manager will also help evolve architectural practices to support modern cloud platforms, integration, generative AI and agentic AI while maintaining appropriate security, resilience and scalability.

  

* Develop and present business cases for strategic architecture-led initiatives, articulating business value, costs, benefits, risks, dependencies and architectural implications to support executive decision-making and investment prioritization.
* Provide architecture leadership throughout project delivery, ensuring key architectural decisions, risks and dependencies are actively managed and that delivered solutions remain aligned with approved target-state architectures, enterprise standards and business objectives.
* Lead the enterprise, domain and solution architecture teams, providing technical direction and oversight for the design and evolution of technology solutions across business applications, platforms and integration capabilities.
* Translate enterprise architecture strategy, standards and target-state direction into practical architectural designs, reference architectures and implementation roadmaps aligned with business and technology priorities.
* Establish and continuously improve architecture practices, design standards, governance processes and decision-making frameworks to promote consistency, reusability and effective technology delivery.
* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership on complex initiatives, helping teams evaluate design options, resolve technical challenges and balance short-term business needs with long-term architectural sustainability.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Technology teams to support modernization initiatives, reduce technical debt, simplify system architectures and improve platform resilience, maintainability and scalability.
* Partner with Data Architecture, AI, Security and Engineering teams to ensure solutions support enterprise integration, secure data access and the adoption of emerging technologies, including generative AI and agentic AI.
* Work closely with FIL and international architecture counterparts to align technology standards, architectural patterns and roadmaps, maximize reuse of global capabilities and contribute to shared enterprise architecture direction.
* Represent Canadian architecture requirements and priorities in global discussions, fostering strong international partnerships and ensuring alignment between local delivery needs and enterprise technology strategies.
* Communicate architecture direction, design decisions and technology recommendations to business and technology stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business implications.
* Manage, coach and develop a team of architects, establishing clear goals, accountabilities, development plans and performance expectations while fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Completed University Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent working experience.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in IT, with a strong focus on enterprise, domain or solution architecture, preferably in wealth management, financial services or another complex regulated environment.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing architects or senior technical professionals.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing complex enterprise technology solutions across applications, integration, cloud and technology platforms.
* Experience establishing and maturing architecture practices, design standards, governance processes and technical decision-making frameworks.
* Experience working with modern cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, enterprise integration patterns, APIs and distributed systems.
* Experience collaborating across business, engineering and technology teams on major transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Experience working in a global organization, collaborating with international architecture and technology teams, and aligning local solutions with enterprise-wide strategies and standards.
* Familiarity with generative AI, agentic AI and their implications for enterprise and solution architecture is an asset.

**The Skills You Bring**

* Strong understanding of enterprise, domain and solution architecture, with the ability to translate business and technology requirements into scalable, secure and sustainable architectural designs.
* Strong technical knowledge across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, integration architectures, APIs, distributed systems and modern technology infrastructure.
* Experience developing architecture principles, reference architectures, design standards and target-state solutions that guide technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of architecture governance, technology modernization, technical debt and technology lifecycle considerations.
* Knowledge of modern software engineering principles, cloud-native architecture and architectural patterns supporting AI-enabled applications and agentic systems.
* Strong technical judgement and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex architectural trade-offs, challenge existing approaches and provide pragmatic recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop technical teams, establish clear expectations and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Strong communication, presentation and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence business, engineering and technology stakeholders and explain complex architectural concepts in business terms.
* Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate with international counterparts, influence shared architectural decisions and balance global technology direction with local business requirements.
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF is an asset.

**Total Rewards That Reflect Your Impact**

We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a **competitive compensation package** designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.

For this role, your total rewards include:

* **Base Salary and Discretionary Performance Bonus**: Total annual cash compensation (base salary plus target bonus) ranges from **$133,000** to **$170,000**, based on experience and qualifications.

**Job Description:**

**Senior Manager Customer Research & Insights**

We are ready to take this game to the next level and need someone passionate about understanding customers, uncovering actionable insights, and shaping business strategy through research as **Senior Manager Customer Research & Insights**. In this role, you will serve as OLG's customer and research expert, leveraging advanced research methodologies and behavioural insights to inform strategic decision-making across all lines of business. You will lead the development and delivery of customer insights that deepen understanding of customer needs, behaviours, experiences, and preferences, while identifying emerging trends and opportunities that drive business performance and enhance the customer experience. As a people leader, you will develop and mentor a team of Customer Insights Managers, champion research excellence and governance, and oversee the vision, planning, budgeting, and continuous evolution of OLG's research and insights capabilities to foster a customer-centric culture across the organization.

**YOUR ROLE IN THE GAME**

Reporting to the Director Enterprise Customer Strategy & Experience, you will be empowered to:

  

* Partner with Customer Experience Strategy, Voice of Customer, Enterprise Data & AI, and business teams to build and publish a shared, evidence-based understanding of OLG customers, including their needs, behaviours, preferences and experiences
* Lead the consolidated customer research and insights portfolio, plan and budget by translating business priorities into a focused research agenda, prioritizing investments and setting the strategic direction of the function
* Lead quantitative and qualitative customer research from business question through research design, analysis and recommendation, ensuring findings are rigorous, actionable and connected to business decisions
* Apply deep expertise across questionnaire design, sampling, weighting, segmentation, tracking and other research methodologies, and translate complex findings into clear implications and recommendations
* Serve as a trusted insights partner to senior leaders, connecting evidence across research, customer feedback, behavioural, transactional and market data to answer complex business questions and inform strategy, product, marketing and customer experience decisions
* Provide counsel, point of view and analysis of third-party research to various internal stakeholders
* Advance OLG’s research and analytics practices by introducing fit-for-purpose methodologies, technologies and tools that improve the quality, speed, reliability and business value of customer insights
* Plan the annual market research budget and monitor the spending on research projects to ensure efficiency and eliminate duplication of efforts by bringing synergy between research projects
* Establish strong relationships with internal partners and external suppliers, and represent OLG’s customer research and insights perspective within ILC by influencing national research priorities, leading cross-jurisdictional projects and collaborating with working groups
* Lead, coach and develop Customer Insights Managers, strengthening their capabilities in research, analytics, storytelling and strategic business partnership
* Lead the bid management process, by drafting RFPs, analyzing and scoring proposals, to select and on-board research suppliers/vendors and liaise with procurement and legal departments to negotiate contracts for vendors/supplies
* Lead and evolve key customer insight capabilities, including customer panels, innovation research and the Customer Insights Hub, with strong governance, data quality and clear business use cases

* Bachelor’s Degree in commerce, economics, psychology, statistics or equivalent. A Master’s in one of these disciplines is an asset.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in customer insights, market research, customer intelligence or a related field, with strong quantitative research and analytical expertise
* Strong hands-on expertise designing and leading quantitative and qualitative research, including questionnaire design, sampling, weighting, segmentation and tracking studies
* Ability to independently interpret data tables, develop tabulation plans, conduct cross-tab and statistical analysis, investigate discrepancies and develop actionable recommendations
* Experience connecting survey and research findings with behavioural, transactional, customer and market data to create a holistic view of the customer and support product, channel, marketing, segmentation and customer experience strategies
* Experience developing customer tracking studies, customer KPIs, measurement frameworks, performance targets and executive reporting; proficiency with research and analytical tools such as Q, SPSS, Qualtrics XM, UserTesting, Power BI or Alteryx
* Expertise working with and analyzing data from syndicated or market reports (E.g., Nielsen, Numerator, etc.)
* Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing teams
* Strong knowledge of the lottery, gaming or gambling industry and its customers is considered an asset

* Research expertise and methodological rigour
* Business judgment and strategic insight
* Analytical curiosity and ability to synthesize multiple sources of evidence
* Executive communication, presentation and customer storytelling capabilities
* Influence, collaboration and senior stakeholder relationship management

Title: Director, Institutional Giving
Description:

**Summary**

Oceana Canada was established as an independent charity in 2015 and is part of the largest international advocacy group dedicated solely to ocean conservation. Oceana Canada has successfully campaigned to ban plastic pollution, end the shark fin trade, make rebuilding depleted fish populations the law, improve the way fisheries are managed and protect marine habitat. Canada has the longest coastline in the world, with an ocean surface area of 7.1 million square kilometres, or 70 per cent of its landmass. Oceana Canada believes that Canada has a national and global obligation to manage our natural resources responsibly and help ensure a sustainable source of protein for the world’s growing population. Oceana Canada works with civil society, academics, fishers, Indigenous Peoples and the federal government to return Canada’s formerly vibrant oceans to health and abundance. By restoring Canada’s oceans, we can strengthen our communities, reap greater economic and nutritional benefits, and protect our future.

Oceana Canada is seeking a Finance and Administration Officer for its Toronto-based operations team, reporting to the Director of Finance and Administration. You will support bookkeeping, revenue processing, and HR tasks, and manage office administration across physical and remote environments, including procurement, mail, facilities, safety compliance, and basic IT support. You will also coordinate sustainability reporting and cross-functional initiatives in a supportive environment to build your skills in finance, administration, and HR.

This role calls for strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and discretion, along with the ability to collaborate across a mission-driven organization and to manage multiple responsibilities while meeting tight deadlines.

Financial

* Assist with accounts payable, including invoicing, expense reports, and payment

* Support with the annual external audit of the organization
* Assist with small donor payment issues including issuing refunds
* Draft donor receipts for payments, as needed
* Maintain financial records (electronic & paper)
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulations
* Other financial duties and project work as assigned

Human Resources

Office Administration

* Liaise with building management to support office-related matters, including maintenance requests
* Maintain and update Oceana Canada’s emergency manual under the oversight of the Director of Finance and Administration
* Ensure safety regulations and procedures are implemented and adhered to
* Main point of contact for preparation and submission of reports related to emissions and plastic-free supply initiatives
* Act as the primary point of contact for country-level systems and tools
* Provide basic IT support in coordination with the outsourced service provider
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Requirements**

* Accounting degree or diploma
* 1 to 2 years of related working experience, preferably with strong knowledge of bookkeeping and financial processes in the non-profit sector
* Strong data entry, mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

Description:

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

Help Scotiabank source the technologies shaping the future of banking.

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment – driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Manager, Strategic Sourcing – covering business line software (e.g., Capital Markets & Wealth Systems) within Technology Sourcing – you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology domains.

  

You'll partner with Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and senior business leaders to unlock enterprise value across SaaS, cloud & hyperscalers, infrastructure, software, networks. This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.
* Build category strategies across SaaS, cloud, software licensing, infrastructure, and telecom anchored in spend analysis, supplier capability, and market trends.
* Design and run competitive events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including evaluation frameworks, shortlisting, negotiation strategy, and award recommendations.
* Negotiate commercially strong agreements balancing TCO, consumption vs. subscription models, service levels, flexibility, exit rights, and long-term business needs.
* Optimize the existing portfolio: identify renewal, consolidation, license rationalization, and vendor rationalization opportunities.
* Partner with Third-Party Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to ensure alignment with policy, regulatory expectations, and the Bank's risk appetite.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships – performance, escalations, executive engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Track and report pipeline, benefits, milestones, and commitments with discipline and transparency.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Technology stakeholders and an escalation point on commercial and supplier matters with enterprise impact.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite, risk culture and risk policies & processes should be considered/adhered to in day-to-day activities and decisions.

* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

* MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.
* 3–5+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier management — with meaningful experience across technology categories and/or a specific business: ie: capital markets, wealth management, or retail banking.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS pricing models, cloud consumption economics, software licensing (perpetual, subscription, token-based), and MSA/SOW constructs.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation capability, backed by data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders (VP/SVP) and lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity.
* Hands-on with spend analytics, supplier segmentation, TCO modelling, and benchmarking .
* Understanding of third-party risk and regulatory expectations in financial services (or another regulated environment) is an asset.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, CLM, and supplier management platforms.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

  

* A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
* An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers.
* A competitive rewards program includes annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.
* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences every individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

Title: Director of Technical Operations
Description:
**Department:**
IT Group
  
  
**Location:**
Clackamas
  
  
****Description****
At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and
*always*
striving to do better.
  
  
****Summary:****
We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented
**Director of Technology Operations**
to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.
  
  
Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* Support Leadership: Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* SLA & Throughput Excellence: Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* Operational Readiness & Business Continuity: Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* ITSM & ITIL Maturity: Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* IT Intake & Demand Management: Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* Enterprise Governance & Compliance: Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement: Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance: Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* Enterprise System Implementations: Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* AI & Automation Readiness: Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* Lean Six Sigma Execution: Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* Root Cause & Corrective Action: Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* Asset & Inventory Optimization: Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Customer-Centric Culture: Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* Executive & Departmental Alignment: Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* Voice of the Customer: Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management: Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* Data-Driven Economics: Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management: Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* Inspirational People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* Cross-Training & Team Resilience: Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* High-Accountability & Morale: Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

****Required:****
**What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

* Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* Proven Operational Impact: Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* Enterprise Transformation: Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* Cross-Industry Fluency: Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* Education: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements**
The Physical Demands Described Here Are Representative Of Those That Must Be Met By a Team Member To Successfully Perform The Essential Functions Of This Job. While Performing The Duties Of This Job, The Team Member:
  
  

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.
* Ability to maintain a stationary position 80% of the time, with intermittent walking, standing, bending, reaching, and/or crawling.
* Ability to move and transport documents, equipment, or other items weighing up to 50 pounds across various locations for different team members, departments, and events.
* Capable of occasional travel as required by duties, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in diverse locations.
* Capable of operating a computer and other office productivity machinery, including a calculator, copy machine, and printer.
* Capable of frequently communicating with team members and stakeholders, accurately conveying detailed or important spoken instructions.
* Capable of perceiving visuals for activities such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer screen, and engaging in extensive reading.

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.*
**Working Conditions**
The Working Environment Characteristics Described Here Are Representative Of Those a Team Member Encounters While Performing The Essential Functions Of This Job. While Performing The Duties Of This Job, The Team Member Is Exposed To:
  
  

* Traditional office environment
* Standard office equipment (computers, printers, phones, etc.)
* Well-illuminated environment
* Quiet to moderate noise level
* Occasional travel via car or plane to regional facilities, events, etc.
* Occasional subtle and mild scents related to operational facilities
* Occasional access to operational or warehouse facilities

****Benefits****
**Total Compensation**
At Pacific Seafood Your Base Wage Is Only a Portion Of Your Overall Compensation Package. We Invest In Our Team Members Through a Comprehensive And Attractive Total Rewards Package, Including But Not Limited To:
  
  

* Health insurance benefits options, including medical, prescription, vision, dental, basic group life and short term disability.
* Flexible spending accounts for health flex and dependent care expenses
* 401(k) Retirement Plan options with generous annual company profit sharing match
* Paid time off for all regular FT team members, to include sick days, holiday pay, vacation, and personal time
* Employee Assistance Program- Confidential professional counseling, financial, and legal assistance provided at no charge to Team Members and immediate family members
* Product purchase program

Pacific Seafood is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Director, Network
Description:
**Join Points of Light and Change the World**

As the world’s largest organization dedicated to increasing volunteer service, Points of Light engages more than 3.8 million volunteers across 32 countries.

Cast from the vision of one thousand points of light shared by its founder, President George H.W. Bush, in his 1989 inaugural address, Points of Light was founded in 1990 as an independent, nonpartisan, nonprofit organization to encourage and empower the spirit of service. The organization extends President Bush’s vision that “any definition of a successful life must include serving others.” Today, Points of Light continues to transcend politics and borders to inspire millions of individuals worldwide to take action.

**Join Us:** Be part of a movement that changes lives and communities. Please read the position description below. For more information, visit pointsoflight.org.

**Salary Range:** $85,000-$105,000 annually

**Reports to:** Vice President, Programs

**Key Partners:**

* Senior Vice President, Strategic Partnerships and Convenings (Global Gathering & Conference Network Gathering)
* Vice President, Corporate Programs
* Marketing Department
* Development Department

**Department:** Programs and Impact

**Location:** Points of Light is a remote-first organization. Any U.S. location in the Eastern or Central time zone in a market with a major airport. Washington, DC preferred.

**Position Summary**:

The Director, Network is responsible for building, strengthening, and growing the Points of Light Global Network, with a core focus on network organizational health, learning, community building, and capacity development. This role leads a comprehensive network strategy that equips affiliates with the tools, relationships, funding pathways, and shared programming needed to thrive and scale impact.

As the steward of affiliate relationships, the Director owns the network-wide relationship management strategy, ensuring affiliates experience a coordinated, high-value partnership across Points of Light. The role works cross-functionally to align network priorities with convenings, corporate engagement, and national strategy, while fostering a strong, connected global community.

The Points of Light Global Network is entering a critical phase of growth and evolution. Affiliates are navigating increasing community needs, funding complexity, and capacity strain, while also seeking deeper connection, shared learning, and stronger alignment with national strategy.

This role exists to ensure the network does not simply grow in size, but grows in strength, resilience, and cohesion. The Director, Network provides the leadership needed to:

* Move from fragmented engagement to a coordinated relationship-based engagement model rooted in belonging;
* Shift from one-off programs to intentional, scalable capacity building;
* Ensure convenings are not just events, but strategic drivers of learning and network health; and
* Align corporate partnerships with affiliate realities and readiness.

**Position Functions and Responsibilities Include:**

**Network Strategy, Growth & Health**

* Lead the vision and strategy for the Global Network, ensuring strong affiliate organizational sustainability, and long-term impact.
* Establish frameworks and shared standards that support affiliate excellence and consistency across the network.

**Learning, Community & Capacity Building**

* Design and implement a network-wide capacity-building ecosystem that promotes organizational sustainability and consistent program implementation including:
  + Professional development and leadership learning,
  + Peer learning communities and communities of practice, and
  + Action groups, grants, turnkey programs, and shared service models.
* Continuously assess network needs and refine learning and support offerings based on data and feedback.
* Strengthen peer-to-peer collaboration and knowledge sharing across affiliates.

**Convenings & Network Programming**

* Co-lead the strategic design and execution of:
  + Global Gathering
  + Conference Network Gathering
* Ensure convenings advance network learning goals, strengthen relationships, and drive measurable outcomes for affiliates.

**Comprehensive Relationship Management & Corporate Alignment**

* Provide strategic oversight of Network relationship management, supporting the Senior Manager’s ownership and execution of the belonging-based affiliate engagement strategy to ensure a coordinated, consistent, and high-quality affiliate experience.
* Partner with Corporate Activation leadership to align corporate opportunities with Network priorities, affiliate capacity, and community needs, supporting holistic relationship management across teams and strengthening affiliate organizational sustainability.
* Provide strategic advice and Network insights to inform Corporate Activation’s training and tools, which are owned and managed by Corporate Activation; support affiliate participation, surface implementation needs, and connect affiliate feedback to continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Development, Marketing, and Corporate Activation to align national partnerships, communications, and engagement opportunities with local affiliate needs and readiness.

**Affiliate Governance**

* Lead the Affiliate Assembly’s agenda, member participation, and strategic contributions, supporting its roles as strategic advisor, source of Network intelligence, and regional connector.
* Guide Assembly membership transitions, orientation, and representative participation in alignment with established governance practices.
* Facilitate substantive conversations that surface emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities and inform Network priorities and decisions.

**Data, Performance Management & Network Insights**

* Leverage Salesforce and related tools as primary systems for relationship management, network insights, and performance tracking, ensuring data informs the network strategy.
* Working with Vice President, Evaluation and Impact, define, monitor, and regularly review key performance indicators (KPIs) for the network, including:

* Affiliate engagement and organizational health,
* Learning and convenings participation and outcomes,
* Affiliate retention, growth, and sustainability indicators, and
* Organizational capacity and readiness measures.
* Championing a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement, using data to test assumptions, evaluate impact, and refine network strategy over time.

**Core Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Exceptional oral and written communication skills.
* A ‘people person’ with excellent customer service skills, an ability to communicate from a place of values and purpose, and an ability to moderate conversations with our global community.
* Excellent organizational skills; precision and strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize accordingly.
* Deep international awareness, preferably including experience living and/or working in non-US environments.
* Comfort working within ambiguity and a rapidly changing environment.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills with a focus on process improvement.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience, including experience in network management or engagement.
* Occasional travel overnight and/or internationally (estimated 15-20%).
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office. Knowledge of Salesforce, program management software (Asana), and data analytics/visualization tools are a plus.
* Fluency in English and proficiency in additional languages a plus.
* Ability to create a welcoming work environment for all.

**Culture and Values:** Points of Light has a 35-year plus history that it seeks to honor, while looking toward the future as an innovative thought leader in the social sector. We have a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Our organization values innovation, dedication, teamwork and respectfulness. We enjoy thinking big, but also working hard to deliver our best work. Our team is solution-oriented, looking for someone who is always ready to deliver on ways to solve challenges, internally and with external partners.

**What We Offer:** Competitive compensation and excellent benefits including a robust PTO program: 18 days of PTO (increases to 20 days after three years of service) and 10 holidays; plus, we are closed December 25-January 1. Medical, dental and vision benefits offered, free life insurance, along with long-term and short-term disability, a 403(b) program with employer match, parental leave and one day of volunteer time off per month.

Title: Operations Manager - Insulators
Description:

----------------

The Operations Manager II coordinates and manages the manufacturing activities of several areas, ensuring to reach the manufacturing volume and quality standards within the approved operation budget.

#LI-SL1

---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Supervising the production tasks, quality, and manufacturing engineering.
* Providing advice, coaching, guidance, and mentoring employees on operations initiatives and necessary changes.
* Planning, organizing, and managing the activities necessary to meet production schedules and cost objectives.
* Selecting and maintaining qualified personnel in all positions reporting directly and supervising the hiring, development, evaluation, and termination, if necessary, of all other personnel responsible for direct reports.
* Executing plans for additional equipment, improved processes, and facilities when required.
* Maintaining safety programs to ensure conformance to company, corporate and government requirements.
* Leading overall strategic planning to include production and productivity improvement activities and growth strategies.
* Ensuring that manufacturing capabilities meet or exceed all industry and customer standards.
* Facilitating a work environment that supports a safe and healthy culture.
* Managing requirements for cost, quality, and responsiveness.
* Preparing the organization for ongoing change.
* Developing and managing the annual operating budget.
* Leading managers to evaluate and take actions that are consistent with the company’s overall strategy.
* Monitoring performance against performance goals to ensure progress is being made.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Management, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience manufacturing management experience (required)
* 10+ years of experience with Lean manufacturing and/or Six Sigma quality processes (required)
* Proficiency in Excel along with all other computer skills (required)
* Strong knowledge of Financial Management
* Experience in a growth-oriented sales and marketing organization
* Bi-lingual (Spanish & English) preferred
* SAP experience preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Title: Program Manager (R-00259)
Description:
